predictions.articleTitle: Inter U23 vs Potenza Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Potenza's 2.79 GPG Attack Break Breda?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Potenza's league-leading 2.79 goals-per-game attack makes an Away Win the primary trajectory against Inter U23, while defensive clean-sheet vulnerabilities on both sides warrant covering Draw / Away Win alongside Over 2.5 and BTTS: Yes.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win anchored on Potenza's 39-goal offensive output and second-half bench depth versus Inter U23's home scoring threat (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals supported by a 3.66 combined goal lambda and aggressive 3-4-2-1 vs 4-3-3 transition profiles (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Both Teams To Score: Yes backed by ~23% and ~15% clean-sheet rates and confirmed availability of both clubs' top forward catalysts (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Potenza's 2.79 GPG quartet tests Inter U23's three-man backline at Breda.

spf.comment: Prioritizes Potenza's 1:2 road-win script via superior attacking depth while formally retaining the 2:2 draw branch given Potenza's ~15% clean-sheet rate and Giannini's absence.

over_under.comment: A 3.66 combined goal lambda (70.8% Poisson Over 2.5) and both teams conceding over 1.25 goals per game strongly favor at least three goals.

btts.comment: Both attacks start their primary scorers while carrying low clean-sheet rates (~23% for Inter U23 and ~15% for Potenza), aligning with a 68.6% Poisson BTTS projection.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Potenza's second-half finishing edge (9.0% Poisson peak), whereas 2:2 covers Inter U23 capitalizing on fresh legs and Potenza's defensive absences.

goals.comment: Three goals (21.0%) and four goals (19.2%) dominate the Poisson total-goals distribution and match both 1:2 and 2:2 game states.

bqc.comment: Inter U23's extra preparation supports a competitive first half before Potenza's post-interval surge forces either a late road win (Draw-Loss) or a shared high-scoring draw (Draw-Draw).
